Name: TOUGHNESS_PARAM_ST
Description: Poise (toughness) during an animation's toughness window. A TAE toughness event names the row (0-255, so only rows up to 255 are reachable) and the weapon whose poise rate counts; row 0 is used whenever no window is active. At the start of a window the character's maximum and current poise are recalculated from the row. Players: maximum = 100 x (Weapon Poise Multiplier x the weapon's EquipParamWeapon Poise Rate + Armor Poise Multiplier x the summed EquipParamProtector Poise Rates). Enemies: maximum = the minimum below (a percentage of NpcParam Toughness).

Fields.Name: Weapon Poise Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplies the poise rate (EquipParamWeapon Toughness Correct Rate) of the weapon named by the TAE event; the result is added to the armor part of a player's maximum poise for the window. Not used for enemies. Retail row 0 (no window) uses 0, so outside windows only armor counts.

Fields.Name: Minimum Poise
Fields.Description: Floor applied at the start of the window: the maximum poise is raised to at least this value, and the current poise is raised to it if it is lower. With Minimum Ignores Multipliers off, this is a percentage of the window's calculated maximum (retail 80 = 80%). With it on, it is a flat value on the 100-based poise scale (players) or a percentage of NpcParam Toughness (enemies); retail rows 160-251 set it equal to Weapon Poise Multiplier x 100. 0 = no floor.

Fields.Name: Minimum Ignores Multipliers
Fields.Description: If enabled, Minimum Poise is taken against the base poise scale (100 for players, NpcParam Toughness for enemies) instead of the window's multiplied maximum. Enemies only get a poise floor from rows with this enabled.

Fields.Name: Stagger Override SpEffect
Fields.Description: Players only. While poise holds, the damage level of incoming hits is replaced through this SpEffect's Damage Level replacement fields (dmgLv_*). -1: chosen from current poise: SpEffect 6354 at 100 or more, 6353 at 70, 6352 at 50, 6351 at 30, else 6350. Retail rows use 6352 or 6353.

Fields.Name: Armor Poise Multiplier
Fields.Description: Players only. Multiplies the sum of the worn armor's poise rates (EquipParamProtector Toughness Correct Rate, four slots) in the maximum poise for the window. Retail 1, or 0.5 in most rows that also set a poise floor.

Fields.Name: PvP Poise Damage Taken Multiplier
Fields.Description: While a toughness window is active, multiplies the poise damage this character takes from player-character attacks. 1 = no change.

Fields.Name: PvP HP Damage Taken Multiplier
Fields.Description: While a toughness window is active and poise isn't broken, multiplies the HP damage (all five damage types) this character takes from player-character attacks. 1 = no change.
